decisions.note: Locator 202361 verifies JP 油断大敵; the Vietnamese idiom preserves the warning against carelessness without following the Chinese paraphrase literally.
Locator 210271 verifies JP 大海の叡智, but this should be normalized together with the sibling 太陽の叡智 / 大地の叡智 terminology family.
Locator 110121 maps to JP 大盛り！ファーストバイト！; the wedding/food wordplay and mixed loanword title need contextual Vietnamese treatment.
Locator 201351 verifies JP 食いしん坊; Háu ăn is the compact natural Vietnamese equivalent for the recovery skill name.
Locator 411061 verifies JP 大自然の鼓動; the Vietnamese rendering preserves the direct image of nature's pulse.

decisions.target_vi: Đại hải trình, ung dung tự tại
decisions.note: Locator 110702211 verifies JP 大航海、飄々と; the Vietnamese title keeps both the great-voyage image and the nonchalant tone.
Locator 204081 verifies JP 大車輪, but the title is polysemous and no repository evidence establishes which Vietnamese sense should be canonical.
Locator 106202211 maps to JP 大どんでんがえし; several natural Vietnamese 'comeback/twist' renderings are possible and no canonical choice is established.
Locator 109401221 verifies JP 天上天下唯我爆走; the title is a deliberate parody/wordplay and should not be flattened into a literal Chinese calque.
Locator 202121 maps to JP 大胆不敵; the Chinese wording is not the JP title and the best compact Vietnamese idiom remains stylistically ambiguous.

decisions.source_zh_cn: 天天晴晴、年年甜甜蜜蜜
decisions.note: Locator 120601 maps to JP もちっと・ハレハレ; the Japanese title contains mochi/festive wordplay that the Chinese source substantially rewrites.
Locator 100403111 verifies JP 天女の羽衣; Vũ y thiên nữ is a concise Vietnamese rendering of the established mythic image.
Public current JP references verify 天意の彼方 for locator 114101211; the poetic title has no established Vietnamese rendering yet.
Locator 203952 verifies JP 天才肌; Tố chất thiên tài captures innate genius rather than literally mirroring the Chinese wording.
Locator 100301111 verifies the exact JP title 天才的技巧; the Vietnamese rendering is direct and stable.
Locator 203541 verifies JP 天真爛漫; Hồn nhiên vô tư is a natural concise Vietnamese idiom for the same quality.
Locator 203831 verifies JP 天賦の才; Tài năng thiên bẩm is the stable natural Vietnamese equivalent.
Locator 202521 verifies JP 天衣無縫; Hoàn mỹ vô khuyết preserves the idiomatic sense of seamless flawlessness.
Locator 203411 verifies JP 努力の結実; translate from the JP concept as Thành quả nỗ lực rather than canonizing the different Chinese idiom.
Locator 109101111 maps to JP 天来のリトルシスター; the mixed poetic/English title lacks a sufficiently stable Vietnamese rendering.
